meta.name: deepglass
meta.description: The deepball arena: a glass bell on a sky caldera. The bell and the stadium shell are drawn by the venue itself; everything else here is yours to move.

zones.name: The Deepglass
zones.welcome: The bell is full and the truce holds. Type /deepglass to start a bout.

deepglass_marshal.name: Marshal Yvette Coralwake
deepglass_marshal.title: Keeper of the Whistle
deepglass_marshal.greeting: Bell is warm and the water is clear, $C. Name your fixture and I will blow the whistle — singles if you want the ball to yourself, or a full three a side if you would rather have someone to blame.

portal_wizard_deepglass.name: Baldemar the Bald
portal_wizard_deepglass.title: Archmage of the Shining Pate
portal_wizard_deepglass.greeting: Told you I would be here first. Baldness travels light, $C. Enjoy the bell, mind the glass, and when you miss the grass of home, say the word: the way back is one shining thought away.

dg_spectator_pace1.name: Merri Sallow
dg_spectator_pace1.title: Deepglass Spectator
dg_spectator_pace1.greeting: They say the ball sings if you hit it hard enough. I came to hear it.

dg_spectator_pace2.name: Josson Brill
dg_spectator_pace2.title: Deepglass Spectator
dg_spectator_pace2.greeting: I cannot sit still before a fixture. Never could. Ask my wife, she is up in the tiers.

dg_spectator_pace3.name: Petta Wavecrest
dg_spectator_pace3.title: Deepglass Spectator
dg_spectator_pace3.greeting: Three lengths of the apron and back is exactly one bout of nerves. I have measured.

dg_spectator_pace4.name: Tam Groundswell
dg_spectator_pace4.title: Deepglass Spectator
dg_spectator_pace4.greeting: Keep to the apron and mind the parapet. The first step off the terrace is a long one.

dg_spectator_yard1.name: Old Cormorant
dg_spectator_yard1.title: Deepglass Spectator
dg_spectator_yard1.greeting: In my day the water was colder and the goals were smaller. Everything else I approve of.

dg_spectator_yard2.name: Harrow Finch
dg_spectator_yard2.title: Deepglass Spectator
dg_spectator_yard2.greeting: I bet three silver on the away side. The pies are how I am coping.

dg_spectator_yard3.name: Corbin Ashvane
dg_spectator_yard3.title: Deepglass Spectator
dg_spectator_yard3.greeting: A bald wizard sold me a portal ride up here. Best copper I ever spent.

dg_spectator_yard4.name: Sesi Brine
dg_spectator_yard4.title: Deepglass Spectator
dg_spectator_yard4.greeting: Match days are the only days the chasm wind smells like fried bread. Follow your nose.

dg_spectator_tier1.name: Bela Rimeglass
dg_spectator_tier1.title: Deepglass Spectator
dg_spectator_tier1.greeting: Best seat in the bowl. You can see the whole bell shiver when it takes a hit.

dg_spectator_tier2.name: Ferrin Saltcask
dg_spectator_tier2.title: Deepglass Spectator
dg_spectator_tier2.greeting: I have held this row since dawn and I will hold it through the whistle.

dg_spectator_tier3.name: Nim Pearlover
dg_spectator_tier3.title: Deepglass Spectator
dg_spectator_tier3.greeting: When the water goes still right before kickoff, the whole stadium holds its breath with it.

dg_spectator_tier4.name: Goodwife Alder
dg_spectator_tier4.title: Deepglass Spectator
dg_spectator_tier4.greeting: My husband thinks I am at the temple. The temple thinks I am with my husband.

dg_spectator_tier5.name: Skipper Vell
dg_spectator_tier5.title: Deepglass Spectator
dg_spectator_tier5.greeting: Sailed every sea there is, and the strangest water I know is hanging right up there.

dg_spectator_tier6.name: Ivo Lanternwake
dg_spectator_tier6.title: Deepglass Spectator
dg_spectator_tier6.greeting: Higher tier, thinner air, better view. The climb is part of the ticket.

dg_spectator_tier7.name: Maud Threadneedle
dg_spectator_tier7.title: Deepglass Spectator
dg_spectator_tier7.greeting: I knit a row every time the ball changes hands. Finished a whole scarf last bout.

dg_spectator_tier8.name: Pello the Hoarse
dg_spectator_tier8.title: Deepglass Spectator
dg_spectator_tier8.greeting: Lost my voice at the last fixture. Worth it. Will do it again today.

dg_spectator_tier9.name: Liva Undertow
dg_spectator_tier9.title: Deepglass Spectator
dg_spectator_tier9.greeting: Do not stand under the bell when a goal collapses. Trust me on the first part.

dg_spectator_tier10.name: Danna Kelp-Braid
dg_spectator_tier10.title: Deepglass Spectator
dg_spectator_tier10.greeting: The pylons hum before a match. Put your hand on one and you can feel the fixtures coming.

dg_spectator_tier11.name: Marlo Spume
dg_spectator_tier11.title: Deepglass Spectator
dg_spectator_tier11.greeting: Sixteen lamps and not one moth. Highest lamps in the world, I reckon.

dg_spectator_tier12.name: Wenna Tidelace
dg_spectator_tier12.title: Deepglass Spectator
dg_spectator_tier12.greeting: I come for the swimming. I stay because the causeway back down is very long.

dg_stallkeeper_pies.name: Pieman Roldo
dg_stallkeeper_pies.title: Match-Day Provisions
dg_stallkeeper_pies.greeting: Hot pies, cold water, and jerky that outlasts the queue. Eat before the whistle, friend, the second half waits for no stomach.

dg_stallkeeper_tonics.name: Sella Phial
dg_stallkeeper_tonics.title: Tonics and Drams
dg_stallkeeper_tonics.greeting: Bruise tonic, nerve tonic, and a dram for the drop off the causeway. The players buy the first two. The spectators buy the third.

dg_stallkeeper_favors.name: Banner-Hag Wynn
dg_stallkeeper_favors.title: Favors and Flags
dg_stallkeeper_favors.greeting: A pouch for your winnings and a bag for your doubts. Buy the pouch, dear, it is the optimistic purchase.

th_gate_captain.name: Gate-Captain Isolde Brack
th_gate_captain.title: Keeper of the Tide Gate
th_gate_captain.greeting: Tidehold keeps the bell, $C, and I keep Tidehold. Causeway is open, the market is loud, and the Warden is in. Mind the rail on the way back down.

th_gate_watch_0.name: Warden Sable Quist
th_gate_watch_0.title: Gate Watch
th_gate_watch_0.greeting: Walk on. The wards are quiet and I would like them to stay that way.

th_gate_watch_1.name: Warden Tomas Reel
th_gate_watch_1.title: Gate Watch
th_gate_watch_1.greeting: Walk on. The wards are quiet and I would like them to stay that way.

th_lamplighter.name: Ondry the Lamplighter
th_lamplighter.title: Keeper of the Crystal Lamps
th_lamplighter.greeting: Every lamp from the causeway to the Seat, and they all want tending before the light goes. Follow me up if you like — it is the best walk in the city.

th_stablemaster.name: Stablemaster Corrin Vane
th_stablemaster.title: Tidehold Stables
th_stablemaster.greeting: Nothing with wings, nothing with a burner. Just honest horses that never fell off a causeway.

th_market_pies.name: Marla Saltmere
th_market_pies.title: Bread and Brine
th_market_pies.greeting: Fresh from the Row ovens, $C. Eat it here — half of it blows off the terrace out there.

th_market_tonics.name: Apothecary Wren Fell
th_market_tonics.title: Tonics and Drams
th_market_tonics.greeting: Bruise tonic, nerve tonic, and something for the drop. Deepball players are my best trade.

th_market_bags.name: Packmaster Hest
th_market_bags.title: Bags and Bindings
th_market_bags.greeting: You cannot carry the Glass Market home in your fists, $C. Ask me how I know.

th_market_reagents.name: Ore-Factor Dunn
th_market_reagents.title: Stone, Bar and Bloom
th_market_reagents.greeting: Everything the Row forges comes up the causeway on somebody’s back. Mine, mostly.

th_smith.name: Forgewarden Yela Brine
th_smith.title: The Tidehold Forge
th_smith.greeting: Glass is the Warden’s business. Steel is mine, and mine holds when the glass does not.

th_banker.name: Coffer-Keeper Ansel Tide
th_banker.title: The Deepglass Vault
th_banker.greeting: Your coin is safer in the rock than in your pocket over a fifty-yard drop, $C.

th_merchant.name: Factor Iselle Coralwake
th_merchant.title: Warden Market
th_merchant.greeting: Half the realm sends its goods up here for the fixtures. Buy, sell, and mind the queue.

th_innkeeper.name: Innkeeper Dov Marrow
th_innkeeper.title: The Gilded Gull
th_innkeeper.greeting: Bed, board and a window facing the bell. You will not sleep on match night, but you will not want to. Board is up by the door if you are looking for company.

th_market_folk_0.name: Netta Halloway
th_market_folk_0.title: Glassmonger
th_market_folk_0.greeting: Fixture day, and the whole terrace is up here buying. Mind your purse and your elbows.

th_market_folk_1.name: Bram Culloch
th_market_folk_1.title: Ropewright
th_market_folk_1.greeting: Fixture day, and the whole terrace is up here buying. Mind your purse and your elbows.

th_market_folk_2.name: Sister Ivo Marn
th_market_folk_2.title: Almswoman of the Tide
th_market_folk_2.greeting: Fixture day, and the whole terrace is up here buying. Mind your purse and your elbows.

th_market_folk_3.name: Sallis Quay
th_market_folk_3.title: Ferry Factor
th_market_folk_3.greeting: Fixture day, and the whole terrace is up here buying. Mind your purse and your elbows.

th_market_folk_4.name: Old Perrin
th_market_folk_4.title: Fixture Tout
th_market_folk_4.greeting: Fixture day, and the whole terrace is up here buying. Mind your purse and your elbows.

th_market_folk_5.name: Yenna Coll
th_market_folk_5.title: Netmender
th_market_folk_5.greeting: Fixture day, and the whole terrace is up here buying. Mind your purse and your elbows.

th_dockhand_0.name: Dockmaster Ferrow Kell
th_dockhand_0.title: The Moorings
th_dockhand_0.greeting: Ships moor to the rock here and hang over the ice. You get used to it, or you go back down the causeway.

th_dockhand_1.name: Riggerwoman Sena Tull
th_dockhand_1.title: The Moorings
th_dockhand_1.greeting: Ships moor to the rock here and hang over the ice. You get used to it, or you go back down the causeway.

th_clerk.name: Clerk Ottoline Vex
th_clerk.title: The Warden’s Hall
th_clerk.greeting: Petitions on the left, fixture disputes on the right, and everything about the causeway rail on my desk.

th_priest.name: Tidespeaker Halloran
th_priest.title: The Chapel of the Still Water
th_priest.greeting: We keep a bowl of the bell’s own water on the altar. It has never once gone cloudy.

th_armourer.name: Quartermaster Rook Adlin
th_armourer.title: The Grand Armoury
th_armourer.greeting: Everything the watch carries, and a little of what it should. The Warden pays; you pay less.

th_row_folk_0.name: Magister Ilvane Doss
th_row_folk_0.title: Warden’s Household
th_row_folk_0.greeting: Up here you can hear the bell when the wind drops. Best address in the city.

th_row_folk_1.name: Goodwife Prell
th_row_folk_1.title: Of the Row
th_row_folk_1.greeting: Up here you can hear the bell when the wind drops. Best address in the city.

th_row_folk_2.name: Anselm Coy
th_row_folk_2.title: Glasswright
th_row_folk_2.greeting: Up here you can hear the bell when the wind drops. Best address in the city.

th_row_folk_3.name: Little Wren
th_row_folk_3.title: Of the Row
th_row_folk_3.greeting: Up here you can hear the bell when the wind drops. Best address in the city.

th_warden.name: Warden Cassia Deepglass
th_warden.title: Warden of the Bell
th_warden.greeting: You came up the whole causeway to look at me, $C? The bell is behind you and it is the only thing here worth the climb. Go and play in it — that is what we keep it for.

th_seneschal.name: Seneschal Aldric Poole
th_seneschal.title: The Warden’s Seat
th_seneschal.greeting: The Warden sees petitioners at the turn of the glass. The glass, in this city, is quite large.

th_keep_guard_0.name: Guard Ottar
th_keep_guard_0.title: The Warden’s Watch
th_keep_guard_0.greeting: The Seat is the Warden’s. The view is everyone’s. Enjoy the second one.

th_keep_guard_1.name: Guard Lisbet
th_keep_guard_1.title: The Warden’s Watch
th_keep_guard_1.greeting: The Seat is the Warden’s. The view is everyone’s. Enjoy the second one.

th_keep_guard_2.name: Guard Vance
th_keep_guard_2.title: The Warden’s Watch
th_keep_guard_2.greeting: The Seat is the Warden’s. The view is everyone’s. Enjoy the second one.

th_keep_guard_3.name: Guard Merrin
th_keep_guard_3.title: The Warden’s Watch
th_keep_guard_3.greeting: The Seat is the Warden’s. The view is everyone’s. Enjoy the second one.

th_fountain_keeper.name: Wellmaster Bryn Cadoc
th_fountain_keeper.title: Keeper of the Wardens’ Fountain
th_fountain_keeper.greeting: The fountain runs with the bell’s own water, $C — piped up under the causeway, if you believe the Wardens. Baldemar likes the spray on his head. Says it keeps the pate shining.

th_bridge_watch_0.name: Spanwarden Kettil Voss
th_bridge_watch_0.title: The West Span
th_bridge_watch_0.greeting: A hundred and thirty yards of stone over black ice, and my job is the rail. Look down if you like — everyone does, once.

th_bridge_watch_1.name: Spanwarden Mara Frost
th_bridge_watch_1.title: The East Span
th_bridge_watch_1.greeting: A hundred and thirty yards of stone over black ice, and my job is the rail. Look down if you like — everyone does, once.
